about: Harvest questions (operator 2026-10-06: "start with a single full harvest dry run ... one good end to end of all topics/value points"): one question per value point, in interview_chapters order, alternating Brobot 1 and 2. Each holds its topic's trigger words, so the value-point list hands out the next point. Edit freely; gopod_harvest_test.go reads it. 2026-10-07 (operator: "decouple assess recouple - best questions & best responses ... use leading questions if need be"): each question leads to its own value point and brings up only its own topic, so it gets that point - not one an earlier question used up (TestHarvestQuestionsGetTheirOwnPoint). end_text goes to both Brobots last: the sign-off. 2026-10-07 (operator: "aggregate/score my overall best questions that produced the best answers ... that's your first set of questions for the video-readiness-scripted run"): each point keeps whichever of its question versions got the best answers across the dry runs so far, as long as it still gets its own point.
